optimization_velocity.stage_rationale: 18 iterations, 22 entries. Two entries battle-tested (7ca56b8b, 056f0a9e), one developing (06920986). ~57% tasks seen. Overall upward trend iters 10-16 (0.0556→0.5000) followed by two-iteration plateau at 0.2778. The reflected failure (Task 639) was execution variance / complexity overload, not a coverage gap — the playbook already contained the exact correct guidance. Failures are shifting from missing coverage to compliance issues: entries exist but are not mechanically executed. 14/22 entries at 0 tests is expected at 57% task coverage but limits signal.

optimization_velocity.recommendation: The two-iteration plateau at 0.2778 after peak 0.5000 may be batch variance (only 1 task reflected per iteration, batch composition varies). The primary challenge has shifted from coverage gaps to compliance: entries like 056f0a9e contain correct guidance that the agent doesn't mechanically execute. The 24e11017 standalone isolation experiment is the right approach — if it works, consider isolating other critical sub-rules from multi-section entries. Continue letting untested entries get natural exposure. Monitor whether the metric recovers on next iteration.
